candidates.violated_requirement: When in state sf2, the next state should unconditionally transition to sf3, but the mutation makes it dependent on the current data input. This will cause incorrect behavior when a non-matching sequence is being processed and the data input is 0, leading to an incorrect transition to s3 instead of sf3.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires that if the first bit of a group does not match the sequence, the module skips the entire group and starts checking from the next group.
